allowed: process RSS and allocator observations for the measured region
output identity and deterministic semantic checks
an operation-scoped committed-bytes-per-second value derived from elapsed time

fixture.slide_text_source: the existing 0437 buffered ODP title/body fixture
fixture.shape_contract: exactly one title and one body text per slide; index order is 0..source_slide_count-1
fixture.text_contract: UTF-8 mixed Unicode/entities/plain text; one interior ASCII space; no CR, LF, tab, edge space, or repeated interior spaces
fixture.append_contract: the new slide is exactly odp_buffered_title(source_slide_count) and odp_buffered_body(source_slide_count)

opaque_member.byte_formula: for i in 0..65536, byte[i] = (i as u8).wrapping_mul(37).wrapping_add((i / 256) as u8).wrapping_add(0x5b)
opaque_member.acceptance: the oracle regenerates the bytes from byte_formula and compares every byte and its SHA-256

checks: manifest XML is well formed and namespace-aware
there is one manifest:file-entry for every full_path
there are no duplicate full paths
there are no extra file entries
every media type equals the value above

archive_identity.untouched_rule: output bytes for every untouched member equal the source bytes byte-for-byte; the oracle also compares each against the independent fixture expectation
archive_identity.content_rule: content.xml is validated by independent semantic readback, not by trusting a producer-reported digest
archive_identity.manifest_rule: manifest identity is validated independently and the output manifest bytes must also equal the source manifest bytes

slide_readback: open source and output with an independent ODP reader or namespace-aware XML reader
read every slide in archive order
require source slide index i to expose the exact expected title/body for i
require output slide index i to expose the exact source title/body for i < source_count
require output slide index source_count to expose the exact append title/body
require no title/body text outside those expected fields

semantic_digest.encoding: SHA-256 over domain, u64 little-endian slide count, and for each slide in order: u64 little-endian title byte length, title UTF-8 bytes, u64 little-endian body byte length, body UTF-8 bytes

text_projection.encoding: title UTF-8 bytes, LF, body UTF-8 bytes; join slides with LF LF; no trailing separator
text_projection.source_expected: the projection of the source fixture
text_projection.output_expected: the source projection followed by LF LF and the append title/body projection

order_digest.encoding: SHA-256 over domain, u64 little-endian slide count, and for each slide: u64 little-endian index, title length/title bytes, body length/body bytes
order_digest.purpose: a separate order-sensitive check in addition to the semantic digest

edit_contract.commit_changed_gate: if the public Commit API exposes a changed/non-noop predicate, it must be true; otherwise the independent output member, semantic, and archive identity gates must prove that one slide was appended
edit_contract.source_immutability: the source archive bytes and source snapshot identity remain unchanged after every iteration
edit_contract.expected_output: the independently prepared expected output archive has the same semantic identity and archive identity as every measured output

outside_region: source fixture generation and archive build
commit, snapshot, transaction, and sink drops
inside_region: writing all committed snapshot bytes to the sink
timing_contract.clock_rule: start Instant immediately before Snapshot::from_bytes and stop immediately after the sink accepts the final committed byte; process and allocator end observations happen before any operation-owned value is dropped
timing_contract.sink_rule: the sink receives the committed archive bytes, not a precomputed expected buffer
timing_contract.latency_claim: owned open-through-commit-and-output interval; corpus setup, argument construction, endpoint observations, independent oracles, hash finalization, and destruction are excluded

report_schema.corpus_manifest_rule: CorpusManifest identifies the source archive and source content.xml; uncompressed_payload_bytes is the canonical source title/LF/body projection length (opaque bytes are separately identified); output identity is carried by this source summary and CaseResult.output_sha256
report_schema.sink_rule: accepted_bytes and sink digest equal output archive bytes and output_archive_sha256; input_bytes equals the canonical output text projection length; authored_part_bytes equals output content.xml length
report_schema.source_reads: not applicable for this owned archive edit; do not report source-backed read counters

operation_metrics.normal_mode: allocator metrics may be absent or explicitly unavailable; never synthesize zero allocations
operation_metrics.allocator_mode: allocation_calls, deallocation_calls, reallocation_calls, failed_allocation_calls, allocated_bytes, deallocated_bytes, live_bytes_before, live_bytes_after, peak_live_bytes_before, peak_live_bytes_after, and region_peak_live_bytes are measured vectors of length 30 with the same sample indices
operation_metrics.rss_scope: full-process RSS observation for the documented process phase; no comparative claim
operation_metrics.warmups: warmups are excluded from retained vectors and reports

rejection_rules: unknown selector or unregistered opt-in selector
wrong source title/body, reordered source slide, or unexpected text
missing, extra, renamed, or altered archive member
opaque member with wrong length, bytes, or manifest media type
styles.xml, meta.xml, or mimetype changed by the edit
manifest with missing, extra, duplicate, or wrong-media-type entry
append slide not exactly the prescribed tail slide
runtime sink length or digest different from the output archive
operation vectors with wrong count or misaligned sample indices

claim or field implying bounded memory, source-backed behavior, physical I/O, end-to-end throughput, or cancellation; an operation-scoped committed-bytes-per-second value is allowed when derived only from the measured elapsed interval
